meta.title: Jean-François BG — Co-founder of Viesigners | Toptal top 3%, UX/UI and CRO
meta.description: Jean-François BG, co-founder of Viesigners: UX/UI and CRO expert declared in the top 3% of the world's web experts by Toptal.

sections.lead: Hybrid expert in digital user experience (UX/UI) and conversion rate optimization (CRO), co-founder of Viesigners with his brother Charles-Erick, and declared in the top 3% of the world's web experts by Toptal.

brief.t: UX/UI, CRO, designing offers and digital experiences.
top 3% of the world's web experts, according to Toptal.
Québec, Canada — French- and English-speaking markets.

sections.text: Interfaces and digital experiences that *free up teams* and win over investors.
prose: With Charles-Erick, Jean-François forms “The BG Twins”. Their work has been recognized by Awwwards, OCTAS, Osentreprendre and Gartner, and helped secure $320M+ in funding for an international scale-up.

items.v: [UX/UI for SaaS and mobile apps](@design-produit): user journeys, design systems, user research.
[Jean-François's Toptal profile](https://www.toptal.com/designers/resume/jean-francois-b-g#XAEE74) — top 3% of the world's web experts.

sections.p: One first conversation is enough to know whether we can help.

a: Jean-François BG is co-founder of Viesigners, a Canadian web micro-agency. He is a hybrid expert in UX/UI and CRO, declared in the top 3% of the world's web experts by Toptal.
Toptal is a network of vetted talent. Jean-François is recognized there among the world's best web experts; his profile can be viewed on Toptal.
Through the [contact page](@contact) or by phone at +1 581-502-1115.
